block_new.brief: 向 arena 追加一个新的内存块 / Append a new memory block to the arena
block_new.details: 块首挂在 `js->blocks` 链头部，实际可用区紧跟在 `JsBlock` 头之后。| The block is pushed onto the head of the `js->blocks` chain and its usable area follows the `JsBlock` header.

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.size: 请求的块容量，小于 `JS_BLOCK_SIZE` 时按 512 KiB 申请 / Requested block size, raised to 512 KiB when smaller

block_new.note: 分配失败直接打印到 stderr 并 `abort()` / Allocation failure is reported to stderr and the process is aborted

hpe_js_alloc.brief: 从 arena 分配 8 字节对齐的已清零内存 / Allocate 8-byte-aligned zeroed memory from the arena

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.size: 请求字节数，向上对齐到 8 的倍数 / Requested byte count, rounded up to a multiple of 8

hpe_js_alloc.return: 指向已清零内存的指针 / Pointer to the zeroed memory
hpe_js_alloc.note: 当前块剩余空间不足时自动追加新块；分配的内存不能单独释放，随 arena 整体回收 / A new block is appended when the current one is full; individual allocations cannot be freed and are reclaimed with the whole arena

hpe_js_strndup.brief: 在 arena 中复制指定长度的字符串 / Copy a string of the given length into the arena

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.s: 源字符串，可为 `NULL` / Source string, may be `NULL`
params.n: 复制的字节数 / Number of bytes to copy

hpe_js_strndup.return: 以 NUL 结尾的新字符串 / The new NUL-terminated string
hpe_js_strndup.note: `s` 为 `NULL` 时按空串处理，结果始终以 NUL 结尾 / `NULL` is treated as the empty string and the result is always NUL-terminated

hpe_js_strdup.brief: 在 arena 中复制以 NUL 结尾的字符串 / Duplicate a NUL-terminated string into the arena

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.s: 源字符串，可为 `NULL` / Source string, may be `NULL`

hpe_js_strdup.return: 复制的以 NUL 结尾的字符串 / The duplicated NUL-terminated string
hpe_js_strdup.note: `s` 为 `NULL` 时产生空串 / A `NULL` input yields the empty string

arena_grow.brief: 扩容 arena 数组：另分配并拷贝旧元素 / Grow an arena-allocated array by allocating anew and copying the old elements

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.ptr: 旧数组，可为 `NULL` / The old array, may be `NULL`
params.old_count: 旧元素个数 / Previous element count
params.new_count: 新元素个数 / New element count
params.elem: 单个元素字节数 / Byte size of one element

arena_grow.return: 新数组的起始地址 / Start of the new array
arena_grow.note: 旧区域成为 arena 垃圾，待 arena 释放时一并回收 / The old region becomes arena garbage and is reclaimed when the arena is released

arena_realloc.brief: 按新字节数重分配 arena 数组 / Reallocate an arena-allocated array to a new byte size

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.ptr: 旧数组，可为 `NULL` / The old array, may be `NULL`
params.n: 要保留的元素个数 / Number of elements to preserve
params.elem: 单个元素字节数 / Byte size of one element

arena_realloc.return: 新数组的起始地址 / Start of the new array
arena_realloc.note: 先按 `n * elem` 分配再原样拷贝，若 `n` 小于原长度会截断 / Allocates `n * elem` bytes and copies verbatim, truncating when `n` is smaller than the old length

js_undef.brief: 构造 `undefined` 值 / Build an `undefined` value

js_null.brief: 构造 `null` 值 / Build a `null` value

js_bool.brief: 由 C 布尔值构造 JS 布尔值 / Build a JS boolean from a C boolean
js_bool.return: 类型为 `JS_BOOL` 的值 / A value of type `JS_BOOL`

js_num.brief: 构造 JS 数值 / Build a JS number

js_num.return: 类型为 `JS_NUM` 的值 / A value of type `JS_NUM`

js_string_len.brief: 由定长字节构造 JS 字符串 / Build a JS string from a byte range

js_string_len.return: 类型为 `JS_STR` 的值 / A value of type `JS_STR`

js_string.brief: 由以 NUL 结尾字符串构造 JS 字符串 / Build a JS string from a NUL-terminated string

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.s: 源字符串，可为 `NULL` / Source string, may be `NULL`

js_string.return: 类型为 `JS_STR` 的值 / A value of type `JS_STR`

js_objval.brief: 把对象指针包装成 JS 值 / Wrap an object pointer as a JS value

js_object_new.brief: 创建一个原型为 `Object.prototype` 的普通对象 / Create a plain object whose prototype is `Object.prototype`

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context

js_object_new.return: 新普通对象 / The new plain object

js_array_new.brief: 创建一个 JS 数组对象 / Create a JS array object

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context

js_array_new.note: 原型取 `Array.prototype`，缺失时回退到 `Object.prototype` / The prototype is `Array.prototype`, falling back to `Object.prototype`

js_func_new.brief: 由 AST 函数节点创建用户函数对象 / Create a user function object from an AST function node

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.code: 函数声明的 AST 节点（取自 `JsNode`）/ AST node of the function declaration

js_func_new.return: 新的函数对象 / The new function object
js_func_new.details: 从形参列表（遇到剩余参数为止）推出 `length`，写入 `name`；非箭头函数还会生成带 `constructor` 的 `.prototype` 对象。| `length` is derived from the parameter list up to the first rest parameter and `name` is set; non-arrow functions also get a `.prototype` object carrying `constructor`.

js_native_new.brief: 创建原生（C 实现）函数对象 / Create a native (C-implemented) function object

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.fn: 原生函数指针 / Native function pointer
params.ud: 透传给原生函数的用户数据 / User data passed through to the native function

js_native_new.return: 类名为 `Function` 的原生函数对象 / The new native function object with class `Function`

js_host_new.brief: 创建宿主对象，把 C 指针暴露给脚本 / Create a host object exposing a C pointer to scripts

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.type: 宿主类型标记（`HPE_HOST_*`）/ Host type tag

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.type: 宿主类型标记（`HPE_HOST_*`）/ Host type tag
params.vt: 可选的属性拦截虚表 / Optional property-access vtable

js_make_host.return: 包装宿主对象的 `JS_OBJ` 值 / A `JS_OBJ` value wrapping the host object

js_host_ptr.brief: 取回宿主对象内的 C 指针 / Retrieve the C pointer held by a host object

params.v: 待检查的值 / Value to inspect
params.type: 期望的宿主类型标记 / Expected host type tag

js_host_ptr.return: 类型匹配时返回宿主指针，否则返回 `NULL` / The host pointer when the type matches, otherwise `NULL`

js_promise_new.brief: 创建一个处于 pending 状态的 Promise / Create a Promise in the pending state

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context

js_promise_new.return: 类名为 `Promise`、`promise_state` 为 0 的对象 / The new object with class `Promise` and `promise_state` 0

js_module_ns_new.brief: 创建模块命名空间对象 / Create a module namespace object

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.mod: 该命名空间所属的模块 / The module this namespace belongs to

js_module_ns_new.return: 类名为 `Module`、无原型的对象 / The new object with class `Module` and no prototype

js_obj_own_prop.brief: 查找对象自身的属性记录 / Look up an own property record of an object

params.obj: JS 对象，可为 `NULL` / JS object, may be `NULL`
params.key: 键名，可为 `NULL` / Key name, may be `NULL`

js_obj_own_prop.return: 命中的属性指针，未找到返回 `NULL` / Pointer to the property, or `NULL` when absent
js_obj_own_prop.note: 只查自身属性，不沿原型链 / Only own properties are searched; the prototype chain is not walked

js_obj_find_prop.brief: 沿原型链查找属性记录 / Find a property record along the prototype chain
js_obj_find_prop.return: 命中的属性指针，未找到返回 `NULL` / Pointer to the property, or `NULL` when not found
js_obj_find_prop.note: 原型链最多上溯 100 层，防止自引用造成死循环 / The chain is walked at most 100 levels to guard against cycles

js_obj_own_has.brief: 判断对象自身是否有某属性 / Test whether an object has an own property
js_obj_own_has.return: 自身存在该属性返回 1 / 1 when the own property exists

js_obj_has.brief: 判断对象（含原型链）是否有某属性 / Test whether an object has a property, prototype chain included
js_obj_has.return: 自身或原型链上存在返回 1 / 1 when found on the object or its prototype chain

obj_add_prop.brief: 为对象追加一条新属性记录 / Append a new property record to an object

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.key: 新属性键名 / Key of the new property

obj_add_prop.return: 新属性记录 / The new property record
obj_add_prop.details: 属性数组按需倍增扩容；新记录的值为 `undefined`、enumerable 为 1。| The property array doubles on demand; the new record starts with an `undefined` value and `enumerable` 1.

js_obj_set.brief: 设置对象属性，不存在则创建 / Set an object property, creating it when absent

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.obj: 目标对象，可为 `NULL` / Target object, may be `NULL`

js_obj_set.note: 数组的 `length` 与 `Symbol.*` 前缀键会被置为非枚举 / Array `length` and `Symbol.*`-prefixed keys are marked non-enumerable

js_obj_set_accessor.brief: 为属性安装 getter/setter 访问器 / Install getter/setter accessors on a property

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.getter: 读取器函数值 / Getter function value
params.setter: 写入器函数值 / Setter function value

js_obj_set_accessor.note: 传入 `undefined` 的一侧保持不变 / A side passed as `undefined` is left unchanged

js_obj_delete.brief: 删除对象的自身属性 / Delete an own property of an object

params.js: JS 运行时上下文（未使用）/ JS runtime context (unused)
params.obj: 目标对象，可为 `NULL` / Target object, may be `NULL`
params.key: 属性键名，可为 `NULL` / Property key, may be `NULL`

js_obj_delete.note: 删除时用 `memmove` 保持其余属性的相对顺序 / Remaining properties keep their order via `memmove`

js_obj_prop_count.brief: 返回对象自身属性个数 / Return the number of own properties

params.obj: JS 对象，可为 `NULL` / JS object, may be `NULL`

js_obj_prop_count.return: 自身属性个数，`obj` 为 `NULL` 时返回 0 / The own property count, or 0 when `obj` is `NULL`

js_obj_own_keys.brief: 收集对象的可枚举自身键名 / Collect the enumerable own keys of an object

params.obj: JS 对象，可为 `NULL` / JS object, may be `NULL`
params.out: out:接收以 `NULL` 结尾的键名数组 / Receives a `NULL`-terminated key array
params.count: out:键名个数 / Receives the number of keys

js_obj_own_keys.return: 键名个数 / The number of keys
js_obj_own_keys.note: 键名数组用 `malloc` 分配，调用方需 `free`；仅枚举 `enumerable` 为真的属性 / The array is `malloc`ed and must be freed by the caller; only `enumerable` properties are included

js_obj_get.brief: 读取属性值（含原型链） / Read a property value, walking the prototype chain

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context

js_obj_get.return: 属性值；未找到或该属性是访问器时返回 `undefined` / The property value, or `undefined` when absent or when it is an accessor
js_obj_get.note: 访问器属性需由 `js_get_prop()` 调用读取 / Accessor properties must be read by calling `js_get_prop()`

key_from_index.brief: 把数值下标格式化为属性键字符串 / Format a numeric index as a property-key string

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.idx: 数值下标（截断为整数）/ Numeric index, truncated to an integer

key_from_index.return: arena 中的十进制键名字符串 / A decimal key string in the arena

js_iter_len.brief: 求可迭代值的元素个数 / Get the element count of an iterable value

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.v: 字符串、数组、Map/Set 或类数组对象 / A string, array, Map/Set or array-like object

js_iter_len.return: 元素个数，无法迭代时返回 0 / The element count, or 0 when not iterable
js_iter_len.details: 字符串按码点计数；Set 用后备存储的键数、Map 用其 `length`、数组用元素的 `length`；类数组（NodeList、arguments 等）取 `length` 属性。| Strings count code points; a Set uses the size of its backing store, a Map its `length`, an array the element `length`; array-likes such as NodeList or `arguments` use their `length`.

set_value_at.brief: 取 Set 后备存储中第 i 个值 / Read the i-th value of a Set's backing store

set_value_at.return: 第 i 个可枚举值，越界或无后备存储时返回 `undefined` / The i-th enumerable value, or `undefined` when out of range or without a backing store

js_iter_at.brief: 取可迭代值第 i 个元素 / Get the i-th element of an iterable value

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.v: 可迭代值 / The iterable value

js_iter_at.return: 第 i 个元素，越界或不可迭代时返回 `undefined` / The i-th element, or `undefined` when out of range or not iterable
js_iter_at.details: 字符串按码点返回单码点子串；Set 返回其第 i 个值；Map 返回 `[键, 值]` 二元数组；数组与类数组用键名下标读取。| A string yields the single-code-point substring; a Set yields its i-th value; a Map yields a `[key, value]` pair; arrays and array-likes are read by numeric key.

js_num_to_string.brief: 把数值格式化为 JS 风格字符串 / Format a number as a JS-style string

obj_class_name.brief: 取对象的类名，缺省为 `Object` / Get an object's class name, defaulting to `Object`

js_array_to_string.brief: 数组的 `toString`：逗号连接元素 / `Array#toString`: join elements with commas

js_symbol_to_string.brief: 把 Symbol 对象转为描述串 / Convert a Symbol object to its description string

js_error_to_string.brief: 把 Error 对象格式化为 `name: message` / Format an Error object as `name: message`

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.o: Error 对象 / The Error object

js_error_to_string.return: arena 中的错误描述串 / The error description string in the arena
js_error_to_string.note: `name` 缺省为 `Error`；`message` 为空时只输出名字 / `name` defaults to `Error`; when `message` is empty only the name is emitted

js_obj_to_string.brief: 生成对象的 `[object Class]` 形式串 / Produce the `[object Class]` form for an object

js_obj_to_string.note: 类名为 `Object` 或 `Module` 时统一输出 `[object Object]` / `Object` and `Module` both render as `[object Object]`

js_object_value_to_string.brief: 按对象种类分派 `ToString` / Dispatch `ToString` by object kind

js_to_number.details: `undefined`→NaN、`null`→0、布尔→0/1、数值原样；字符串解析前缀，空串为 0、含非法尾随为 NaN；对象先 `ToPrimitive` 再递归。| `undefined` gives NaN, `null` gives 0, booleans give 0/1 and numbers pass through; strings parse a prefix, empty strings yield 0 and invalid trailing text yields NaN; objects are primitived first and then converted recursively.

js_truthy.brief: 语义上的 `ToBoolean` 抽象操作 / The abstract `ToBoolean` operation

params.v: 任意 JS 值 / Any JS value

js_truthy.return: 真值返回 1，假值返回 0 / 1 for truthy values, 0 for falsy ones
js_truthy.note: falsy 为 `undefined`、`null`、`false`、`0`、`NaN`、空串；对象恒为真 / Falsy values are `undefined`, `null`, `false`, `0`, `NaN` and the empty string; objects are always truthy

js_values_equal.details: 严格模式要求类型一致；宽松模式做数值/字符串互转、布尔转数、`null`≡`undefined`，对象与原始值比较时先求其原始值。| Strict mode requires matching types; loose mode coerces number/string, converts booleans to numbers, treats `null` and `undefined` as equal and primitives an object before comparing it.

js_is_callable.brief: 判断值是否可调用 / Test whether a value is callable

params.v: 任意 JS 值 / Any JS value

js_is_callable.return: 函数或原生函数返回 1 / 1 for functions and native functions

js_primitive_of.brief: 对象到原始值的 `ToPrimitive`（default 提示）/ `ToPrimitive` on an object with the default hint

params.v: 待转换的值 / Value to convert

js_primitive_of.return: 原始值；非对象或无法转换时返回其字符串形式 / The primitive value, or the string form when the input is not an object or conversion failed
js_primitive_of.details: 数组与 Promise 直接走字符串形式；其余先调用自身 `valueOf()`，再 `toString()`，返回非对象结果即采用。| Arrays and Promises go straight through the string form; otherwise the object's own `valueOf()` then `toString()` are invoked and the first non-object result is used.

js_is_thenable.brief: 判断值是否为 thenable / Test whether a value is thenable

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.v: 任意 JS 值 / Any JS value

js_is_thenable.return: Promise 或带可调用 `then` 的对象返回 1 / 1 for a Promise or an object with a callable `then`

js_make_error.brief: 创建 Error 对象 / Create an Error object

js_throw_value.brief: 抛出值并展开到最近的 try 帧 / Throw a value and unwind to the innermost try frame

params.line: 行号，大于 0 时前缀 `line N:` / Line number, prefixed as `line N:` when positive
